_comment: Generated by tools/vanilla_scope.py --datapack. Do not edit; change art/vanilla-scope.json.

notes: ModifyCustomSpawnersEvent: drop remove_custom_spawners whose mob is in #kimetsu:removed_mobs

FinalizeSpawnEvent (setSpawnCancelled) and, on the logical server, EntityJoinLevelEvent for every join: cancel a #kimetsu:removed_mobs mob the modifiers can't stop (spawners, eggs, commands, old chunks)
LivingConversionEvent.Pre: cancel a conversion into a #kimetsu:removed_mobs mob (lightning makes a pig a zombified piglin; a conversion never fires FinalizeSpawnEvent)
EntityJoinLevelEvent, logical server only: replace a #kimetsu:converted_mobs mob with its convert entity, keeping its custom name and position

LivingDropsEvent: remove stacks in #kimetsu:removed, and potion, splash, lingering and tipped-arrow stacks whose potion_contents is in #kimetsu:removed (potion), from every mob's drops (a witch's potion, gear the spawn code gave)
#kimetsu:removed (entity_type) also lists projectiles and other non-mobs: never cancel spawns from it; the safety net reads #kimetsu:removed_mobs

a world from an earlier milestone keeps what it already has: generated blocks, stacks, and merchants' offers (drop offers whose result or cost is removed when a merchant loads, PROPOSED); the M5 scope assumes a new Taisho world
strip_removed_items.json needs the kimetsu:strip_items codec; until it's registered NeoForge logs and skips it, and kept tables still drop the loot_leaks
a tool stand-in's minecraft:tool component copies the vanilla tool's rules (the blade: the sword's cobweb, sword_instantly_mines and sword_efficient rules), or the drops that need that tool are lost
